name: generic-lightbox-gallery
description: Open a visible thumbnail gallery and save unique still images from a lightbox that advances with Right Arrow.

stages.goal: Open the first genuine gallery image in a single-image lightbox or viewer.
stages.guidance: Use the page's main image gallery. Avoid logos, avatars, ads, navigation, account controls, and destructive controls. Return done only when one enlarged still image is visible.

collection.inspectionPrompt: Accept only when a single enlarged still image from the page's primary gallery is visibly open. Reject thumbnails, page screenshots, videos, ads, logos, avatars, placeholders, and ambiguous content.
